media.alt_text: Dedicated gluten-free kushiage dish at Gluten Free Kushiage Su in Tokyo

caption.body:
Gluten Free Kushiage Su in Tokyo — entirely dedicated gluten-free kushiage. Everything's deep-fried in dedicated GF oil, served course by course at the counter. No gluten in the building.

Eating fried food without worrying about cross-contamination is rare for me as a celiac. 5/5 on my GF safety scale.
